query: INSERT INTO devices (id, name, model, os_version, token_hash, paired_at, revoked) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name, model = excluded.model, os_version = excluded.os_version, token_hash = excluded.token_hash, paired_at = excluded.paired_at, revoked = 0
